prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit paint_mask_guide.png (first input), using design_reference.png (second input) as the approved material/detail reference and icon_x8.png (third input) as the colour reference; magenta is background only.
Produce ONE transparent PNG, 3:4 canvas, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Preserve the guide's exact object positions, sizes, outlines, openings, and orthographic views. Paint grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.
The guide is three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and 3-4 repeat the same five model renders: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Preserve this exact layout.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour. Fuzzy slippers shaped like sleepy green-grey furry rabbits: each toe is a rabbit face with closed eyes, a pink nose and a long floppy ear laid back along the side, on a soft pale-pink fur sole; low, no shaft. Match approved reference details and original icon palette. Fine fur surface detail without changing silhouettes. Keep the same views, not the references' perspective.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours ONLY. No shading, texture, outlines, or antialiased colour blends inside. Pure red #FF0000 for metal; pure green #00FF00 for leather (straps, padding, hide, suede) AND FUR; pure blue #0000FF for cloth (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) AND HAIR; pure yellow #FFFF00 for matte nonmetal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax). These slippers are fur-covered with soft padding, so their fur and padding including pink fur soles and ear surfaces must be solid pure GREEN in masks. Every silhouette pixel exactly one allowed colour; nothing outside silhouettes.
Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls if present follow reference scaled to view. Keep every gap/opening exactly as guide and fully transparent. Empty cells column 3 row 2 and row 4 remain fully transparent. No lighting, shadows, AO, hot highlights, reflections, glow, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text. Preserve transparent background and full original layout.
CORRECTION REQUIRED: Strictly clip every painted pixel and every mask pixel to the corresponding original guide silhouette. The previous attempt had extensive green overspray outside the lower silhouettes and red/yellow speckles around upper views: eliminate ALL of that. Background must be clean alpha zero everywhere outside original objects. Lower mask shapes are clean solid #00FF00 cutouts with no outlines, no internal lines, no grain, no overspray. Match the original guide exactly; do not use fuzzy boundaries that expand its silhouettes.
validation: Visual inspection: colour spill remains outside silhouettes after one corrective regeneration; does not fully satisfy brief. Raw tool output preserved unchanged.
